text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Uses several article details and explains them in each body paragraph","quality":"evidence integration","description":"The essay brings in source details repeatedly and ties them to the writer's claim rather than just mentioning them."},{"evidence":"Explains sensors, vibrating seats, and driver alerts as safety benefits","quality":"reasoned elaboration","description":"The essay develops each example with a clear explanation of how it supports the position."},{"evidence":"Has a clear opening claim and a closing restatement of the position","quality":"organization","description":"The essay follows a recognizable introduction-body-conclusion structure that makes the argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"Connects each example to a safety claim","quality":"claim development","description":"The essay consistently returns to one central idea about why driverless cars are beneficial."},{"evidence":"More detailed explanation of how driverless cars prevent crashes","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay goes beyond naming features by showing the practical effect those features would have."}]}
